decisions.mark: states that the shipped mbedtls_config.h leaves BOTH threading macros undefined, so a default build defines neither
decisions.detail: QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also commented out (lines 2185, 2196). | WHY: The answer states the shipped config header leaves THREADING_C and the PTHREAD/ALT macros commented out, so the default build defines none of them. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also commented out (lines 2185, 2196). | WHY: The answer says the shipped config header leaves the threading macros (THREADING_C, PTHREAD, ALT) commented out, so a default build defines none of them. || QUOTE: `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is commented out in `include/mbedtls/mbedtls_config.h:3787` (`//#define MBEDTLS_THREADING_C`). `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` are also commented out (lines 2185, 2196). | WHY: The answer says the shipped config header leaves THREADING_C, THREADING_PTHREAD and THREADING_ALT commented out, so a default build defines none of them. That covers both threading macros the item names.
